pages.text: Autumn wind filled the yard with fallen leaves. Mio came out with a broom.
"I will sweep this whole yard." Mio adjusted their grip.
Mio swept leaves to one side. A little pile formed.
A gust blew. The leaves scattered across the yard again.
Lala came with a broom. Mio turned away and kept sweeping.
Mio swept and swept. The yard looked just as it had before.
Mio stood leaning on the broom. Sweat dotted their forehead.
Teacher Bau stood four brooms in the yard, then looked at the children.
Mio handed the friends one broom each. All five pushed leaves from every side toward the middle.
A mountain of leaves grew in the middle of the yard. All five plunged into it. Leaves fluttered into the sky.
